lines.port: /* VISIBLE WILDS (the OPTIONS row; event_object_movement.c does the walking): a wild Pokemon seen in the grass of any map that has a
* land table is picked from that table by the game's own routines (so species, levels, the LeafGreen and night variants are the
* ones a step in the grass would give), and touching it starts the ordinary wild battle with that species, that level and the
* gender its picture showed (the personality is rolled again, with the game's own generator, until the gender matches; the
* shiny roll stays the game's). The Repel test is the game's: a Pokemon a Repel would keep off is neither seen nor fought. Not in
* the Safari Zone (its battles are not this one) and no Unown (their letter depends on the chamber's slot). */
bool8 CtrWilds_Start(u16 species, u8 level, u8 gender)
// VISIBLE WILDS (OPTIONS, off by default): wild Pokemon are seen in the grass of any map that has a land table, and the battle starts
// when the player walks into one, presses A facing it, or a stronger one catches up. Each is an object event with its own local id
// (CTR_WILD_LOCALID + slot), drawn like the companion: the object itself is the Boy's (his palette, so no object palette is spent) and
// the compositor shows the Pokemon's picture from the pack in its place when the pack has one (the female picture when the Pokemon
// is female and the pack has it). Species and level come from the map's land table (CtrWilds_Pick, wild_encounter.c), so no data
// table is added; the walking is the game's wander movement, and the battle is the ordinary wild battle with the gender that was
// shown (CtrWilds_Start). Design after Wilds of Hoenn (MIT): they appear just outside the screen (the game keeps object events
// inside its view, so the spawn ring is the band between the screen and that view), one at a time every 1.5 to 4 seconds, up to
// CtrWilds_Max() (Old 3DS 2, New 3DS 4), one that is not on the screen after a while is retired, and a wild that notices a
// player who is close (2 tiles on foot, 4 running or biking) judges level x base stats against the lead Pokemon: much weaker ->
// it runs a few tiles off, much stronger -> it walks up to the player (the player can outrun it), an even match ignores them.
// Nothing is kept: on a map without a land table, with the option off, with encounters disabled or a save that left one behind,
// they are removed. Spawning spares the object events (never fewer than CTR_WILD_SPARE are left free) and makes none in the quest
// log or the Union Room. Its own generator picks where, when and the reaction; the game's Random() is drawn on only when a species
// is picked, and that happens after a free grass cell was found, never for an attempt that finds none (the game's wander movement
// uses it too, as every NPC does). With the option off and nothing out, the per-frame update returns at once.
#define CTR_WILD_SPARE 4        // CTR_WILD_LOCALID and CTR_WILD_MAX are in event_object_movement.h
extern int CtrWilds_Max(void);                  // 3ds_game_bridge.c: 2 on an Old 3DS, 4 on a New 3DS
extern bool8 CtrWilds_Start(u16 species, u8 level, u8 gender);
static u8 sCtrWildSteps[CTR_WILD_MAX];          // steps left of a flight or a chase
static u16 sCtrWildCool[CTR_WILD_MAX];          // frames before it may notice the player again
static u16 sCtrWildAge[CTR_WILD_MAX];           // frames since it appeared
static u8 sCtrWildCharge;                       // slot + 1 of a chaser that stands next to the player
static u8 sCtrWildAny;                          // a slot is in use (or the map just changed): the update has work
static u16 sCtrWildMap = 0xFFFF;                       // the map the slots were last checked on
static bool8 CtrWild_IsGrass(s16 x, s16 y)
// A cell just outside the screen but still inside the game's object event view, on the left, right or bottom (the view has no
// margin above): 1 tile past the screen edge at least, so nothing pops in. FALSE when the roll found no grass or a taken cell.
static bool8 CtrWild_RingCell(const struct ObjectEvent *player, s16 *outX, s16 *outY)
s16 halfW = DISPLAY_WIDTH / 32 + 1, halfH = DISPLAY_HEIGHT / 32 + 1;    // the screen, with a tile for the partial one
s16 left = gSaveBlock1Ptr->pos.x - OBJECT_EVENT_VIEW_LEFT, right = gSaveBlock1Ptr->pos.x + OBJECT_EVENT_VIEW_RIGHT;
s16 top = gSaveBlock1Ptr->pos.y + OBJECT_EVENT_VIEW_TOP, bottom = gSaveBlock1Ptr->pos.y + OBJECT_EVENT_VIEW_BOTTOM;
x0 = left; x1 = px - halfW - 1; y0 = top; y1 = bottom;
else if (side == 1)     // right of the screen
x0 = px + halfW + 1; x1 = right; y0 = top; y1 = bottom;
x0 = left; x1 = right; y0 = py + halfH + 1; y1 = bottom;
if (!CtrWild_IsGrass(x, y) || GetObjectEventIdByPosition(x, y, player->currentElevation) != OBJECT_EVENTS_COUNT)
u8 level, tries, free, id, gender;
if (tries == 10 || !CtrWilds_Pick(&species, &level))       // the species is picked only once there is a cell for it
static u32 CtrWild_Power(u16 species, u8 level)
// One roll as the player comes close: level x base stats against the lead Pokemon's. Under 70% of it a wild Pokemon may flee,
// over 130% it may chase; the chance is 10% just past the limit and 50% at 30% / 200%. An even match never reacts.
// A step for a wild Pokemon that is fleeing or chasing, on grass only and never into anything the game's collision refuses.
static bool8 CtrWild_Step(u8 slot, struct ObjectEvent *wild, s16 dx, s16 dy)
// toward the player: the longer axis first, then the other; away from them: the same two, turned around
first = xFirst ? (dx > 0 ? DIR_EAST : DIR_WEST) : (dy > 0 ? DIR_SOUTH : DIR_NORTH);
second = xFirst ? (dy == 0 ? (CtrWild_Rand() & 1 ? DIR_SOUTH : DIR_NORTH) : (dy > 0 ? DIR_SOUTH : DIR_NORTH))
// One field frame of a wild Pokemon's mind: it notices the player (CtrWild_Judge), flees a few tiles or walks up to them, and
// rests a while before it may notice again. A chaser that stands next to the player waits for CtrWilds_TryCharge.
static void CtrWild_Think(u8 slot, struct ObjectEvent *wild, const struct ObjectEvent *player)
s16 dist = CtrWild_Abs(dx) > CtrWild_Abs(dy) ? CtrWild_Abs(dx) : CtrWild_Abs(dy);
return;                                 // mid-step: the next one waits for it
sCtrWildCharge = slot + 1;              // it has caught up: the field input starts the battle
// the run or the chase is over: back to wandering after a rest; a runner far enough away is gone with a 30% chance
bool8 fresh = map != sCtrWildMap;       // a new map: one pass to remove what a save kept
return;                             // the option is off and nothing is out: nothing to do
continue;                       // nothing in this slot, and no new map to look for leftovers
CtrWild_Forget(slot);           // the game removed it (out of view, another map)
CtrWild_Remove(slot);           // option off, left the map, over the cap, or one that a save kept
// retired quietly after a while, but only when nobody can see it
// Every frame the player's field input runs (field_control_avatar.c): a chaser that stands next to the player, who is not in the
// middle of a step, starts its battle. A Repel (its level is blocked) or disabled encounters calm it down instead.
if (wild == NULL || sCtrWildMood[slot] != CTR_WILD_CHASE || id >= OBJECT_EVENTS_COUNT
// VISIBLE WILDS: a stronger wild Pokemon that walked up to the player starts its battle.
|| CTR_IS_WILD_LOCALID(gObjectEvents[objectEventId].localId)   // no script: a wild Pokemon is handled by CtrWilds_TryBattle
// VISIBLE WILDS (OPTIONS): wild Pokemon seen in the grass of maps with a land table; local ids 0xF0 to 0xF3.
